claims.author: Claudius Ptolemy / J.M. Ashmand trans.
claims.locus: Tetrabiblos Book I Chapter IV (Ashmand p.13)
claims.original_claim: Saturn mainly produces cold, being farthest from solar heat and from earthly vapours.

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter VIII Nature (1659 p.57–58)
claims.original_claim: Saturn is a diurnal planet, cold and dry, being far from the Sun's heat and moist vapours.

claims.author: Claudius Ptolemy / J.M. Ashmand trans.
claims.locus: Tetrabiblos Book I Chapter IV (Ashmand p.13)
claims.original_claim: Saturn also produces dryness, but more weakly than it produces cold.

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter VIII Nature (1659 p.57–58)
claims.original_claim: Saturn is named cold and dry, melancholy, earthly.

claims.author: Claudius Ptolemy / J.M. Ashmand trans.
claims.locus: Tetrabiblos Book I Chapter IV (Ashmand p.13)
claims.original_claim: The cooling follows from Saturn being most remote from the Sun's heat and from earth's vapours.

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter VIII Nature (1659 p.57–58)

claims.author: William Lilly

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter VIII Manners when well dignified (1659 p.58)
claims.original_claim: When well dignified: reserved in speech, patient in labour, grave in dispute, austere in conduct.
claims.normalized_claim: Dignified Saturn: reserved, patient, austere, grave

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter VIII Manners when well dignified (1659 p.58)
claims.original_claim: When well dignified, Saturn is studious and solicitous in obtaining the goods of this life.
claims.normalized_claim: Dignified Saturn is solicitous of material goods

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter VIII When ill (1659 p.58)
claims.original_claim: When ill: envious, covetous, jealous, mistrustful, sluggish, suspicious, stubborn, never contented.
claims.normalized_claim: Debilitated Saturn: suspicion, envy, sluggish discontent

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter VIII Colour and Motion (1659 p.57)
claims.original_claim: Saturn is slow in motion and finishes the zodiac in about 29 years; daily motion only a few minutes.
